page: Microsoft Azure D2ls_v5 is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine belonging to the DLSv5 server family. It is provisioned with 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 1 physical core of an Intel Xeon 8370C processor running at 2.8 GHz. The system includes 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a low memory-to-vCPU ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It features no local storage, requiring external storage solutions, though it is premium storage capable. There are no GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses included.

Benchmark data reveals average single-core performance but poor multi-core and memory capabilities. The stress-ng single-core CPU test scored 1889.98, and the Geekbench single-core score reached 1589.0. However, the multi-core stress-ng score of 1932.38 and the Geekbench multi-core score of 1861.0 are categorized as poor. Memory bandwidth is also limited, with read-only large block transfers at 14.32 GB/sec and write large block transfers at 13.3 GB/sec, both falling into the poor performance tier.

Due to the low memory allocation and poor multi-core scaling, this server exhibits performance bottlenecks under concurrent workloads. Passmark database operations scored 1018.8, and Redis SET operations achieved 1.98 million operations per second, both rated as poor. The instance is suited for lightweight, single-threaded tasks, basic web serving, or small-scale development workloads that do not require high memory density or intensive multi-threaded processing.
